Industrial Temp & Humidity SensorSKU: THM-30MD

THM-30MD

Applications

Where THM-30MD is deployed

HVAC Systems Cold Storage Pharmaceutical Greenhouse Cleanroom Server Room Warehouse Food Storage Precision Temperature & Humidity Sensor for Industrial Reliability

When your operations demand accuracy, stability, and long-term durability, the THM-30MD delivers. Powered by the high-performance SHT30 Sensirion sensor, this device ensures precise environmental monitoring in even the toughest industrial conditions. Protecting your equipment, processes, and products.

Guard your operations with precise data.
The THM-30MD gives you the insight you need to maintain optimal conditions, maximize efficiency, and protect what matters most.

Key Features

Why facility managers choose THM-30MD

01

High-Precision Sensing

±0.3°C / ±2%RH accuracy across full range. SHT30 Sensirion-grade element with calibration stability over years.

02

Modbus RTU Native

Direct RS-485 Modbus output. Plug into any PLC, SCADA, BMS, or IoT gateway. Configurable slave ID and baud rate.

03

IP65 Industrial Housing

Dust-tight + jet-water resistant. Stainless probe for food/pharma cleanroom hygiene. Wall & duct mounting.

04

Wide Operating Range

-40°C to +80°C, 0-100%RH range. Suitable for cold storage, greenhouse, server rooms, and outdoor enclosures.

05

Wide Supply Voltage

Powered by 5-38VDC. EMC compliant for stable readings without electrical interference in noisy industrial environments.

06

Quick DIN Rail Install

35mm DIN rail mount for hassle-free panel deployment. Low-power MCU design minimizes drift while saving energy.

Order on Tokopedia → Download Datasheet
FAQ

THM-30MD | Frequently Asked Questions

What is the sensor accuracy?±0.3°C for temperature and ±2%RH for humidity across the full operating range. The Sensirion-grade element delivers calibration stability over years of continuous operation with minimal drift.
What output protocol does THM-30MD use?Modbus RTU over RS-485 with configurable slave ID and baud rate (4800-115200). Plug-and-play with any PLC, SCADA, BMS, or IoT gateway. Standard 9600-8-N-1 default settings.
Is it IP-rated for outdoor or wash-down use?Yes. IP65 dust-tight and jet-water resistant housing with stainless probe. Suitable for food/pharma cleanroom hygiene, outdoor weather stations, and HVAC duct mounting.
What is the operating range?-40°C to +80°C temperature, 0-100% relative humidity. Wide range supports cold storage, greenhouse, server room, outdoor enclosure, and standard industrial environments.
